Name: Woodworking
Author: SaakiFeniya
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This is my first selfmade Mod. It is about Woodworking and for the moment mainly about Woodcarving with a new machine and artisan goods.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]In order to be able to use the Mod you need following Mods[/color]
[/size]
[list]
[*]Smapi[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Extra Machine Config[/*]
[/list]Put those three with the woodworking mod into your stardew valley/mods folder.


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]For the time being it adds a new Machine, 5 dropable Logs from trees and 10 Artisan Goods.[/color][/size]


[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Future Ideas and Plans[/b][/size][/color]

As of now those are the following

[list]
[*]More Artisan Goods[/*]
[*]Recipes to get Logs besides chopping Trees[/*]
[*]i18n Language Support[/*]
[*]Compability with other Mods like SVE and VMV (because they bring new Tree Types)[/*]
[*]Practicing Art so i can replace them maybe with better ones or hire someone for it[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]A very big Thank you to the Stardew Valley Discord, but especially to Selph, TechnicalityCreations, Mr. Duck, who helped me the most, when i was struggling with different Things :)[/color][/size]
